description: This file contains the definition of the 'aCase' class, which models a customer support case in the SuiteCRM system. It includes properties for case attributes, methods for relationship management, data retrieval, and display logic, as well as security and email handling features.

classes.name: aCase
classes.description: This class models customer support cases within SuiteCRM, encapsulating case details, relationships with other entities, security, and email processing functionalities.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns a string summary of the case, primarily its name.

methods.name: listviewACLHelper
methods.description: Provides access control helper data for listing views, especially related to account access.

methods.name: save_relationship_changes
methods.description: Saves changes in relationships, specifically associating contacts with the case.

methods.name: set_case_contact_relationship
methods.description: Establishes a relationship between the case and a contact by contact ID.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional fields like assigned user names and related account info.

methods.name: get_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves contacts related to the case.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data suitable for rendering in a list view, including formatted fields and action links.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Constructs a SQL WHERE clause for search functionality based on a query string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Sets email notification content with case details using a template engine.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates which interfaces the bean implements, e.g., ACL.

methods.name: getEmailSubjectMacro
methods.description: Retrieves the macro pattern used for email subject lines related to cases.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Fetches associated account information for a specific case ID.
